install.windows: Use the official Windows installer linked at https://docs.devin.ai/cli or the official PowerShell installer https://static.devin.ai/cli/setup.ps1 . The script verifies the bundle hash and ends with interactive devin setup; run the interactive stage in a user-visible terminal. Detect an existing desktop-bundled CLI before downloading.
install.macos: Use brew install --cask devin-cli or the official https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh installer in a visible terminal. Reuse a working desktop-bundled CLI.
install.linux: Run the official https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh installer in a visible terminal. Reuse a working desktop-bundled CLI.

install_flow.summary: Detect existing installations first, install the requested application using the official platform/architecture package, then refresh detection.
agent_steps: Check the requested application and existing desktop/CLI executable paths. A CLI-only installation does not provide Devin desktop.
Use the official download or installer for the detected OS and architecture. Preserve existing settings and account credentials.
Complete the installer or interactive setup, then verify the requested executable and version. Do not treat download completion as installation completion.
Refresh both application cards. The desktop installation also supplies a usable CLI.
